name: Paws on the Highway
creator: @thealesch
description: Drive an endless highway at dusk and swerve around kittens and dogs. Grab spare tires, nitro, shields, stars and jets to chase a high score.
instruction: Switch lanes to dodge kittens and dogs. Grab pickups for boosts and lives.
objective: Drive as far as you can before you run out of spare tires.
controls: Tap left or right side, or use the arrow buttons, to change lanes.

creation.intent: A cozy one-thumb endless driver: swerve between three lanes around wandering kittens and dogs, collect pickups and drive as far as you can before the spare tires run out.
creation.playerFantasy: Cruise a highway through a full day and night in a little red car, keeping every stray pet safe while the road gets busier.
creation.coreLoop: Change lanes to avoid animals, grab pickups (spare tire, nitro, shield, 2x points, star, jets), earn points for distance, close calls and fly-bys, and lose a tire on each contact until none are left.
creation.whyFun: Instant lane switches, forgiving hitboxes and generous power-ups make every near miss feel earned, while the day/night cycle with headlights and eyeshine keeps the road readable and fresh.
creation.progression: Speed ramps from 240 to 600, two-lane blocks begin after 1500 distance, crossing animals after 6000, and difficulty reaches full at 30000; higher scores come from surviving longer and chaining pickups.
constraints: Portrait, one-thumb touch controls with on-screen arrow buttons; arrow keys on desktop.
No network, storage or remote code; scores go through the platform score API only.
Canvas 2D scene with a game-owned WebGL2 post pass on the SDK canvas; Canvas 2D fallback without WebGL2.
weakSpots: Casual client-reported scores are not proof of verified play.
The display font falls back to system fonts because web fonts cannot be loaded.

scoring.rationale: Points reward distance driven plus skillful play: close calls, fly-bys, star and nitro bounces, pickups and the 2x multiplier.
scoring.measurement: The submitted scalar is the run's final integer score in points when the last spare tire is gone.
scoring.fairness: Shared ranks use the earliest best submission; scores are casual and client-reported.

preserves: Keep animals unharmed: contact always makes them hop away safely.
Keep one-thumb lane controls and the platform lifecycle.
changes: Remixers should describe their gameplay, tuning or presentation changes.
open: Tune pickups, difficulty ramp, day/night palette and the post-processing look.
attribution: Original game: Paws on the Highway by @alesch, ported from a single-file HTML5 canvas game.
